landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need to really learn
landing.f1d: Play a single verse, repeat it, slow it down, or loop a whole passage.
landing.f2d: Every word lights up as it is recited, with transliteration and meaning.
landing.f3d: Read the classical commentary for the verse you are listening to, with sources.
landing.f4d: Hide words, recite from memory and let spaced repetition tell you what to review today.
landing.f5d: Big colors, simple buttons and star rewards – learning that children enjoy.
landing.f6d: German, English, Arabic, French, Spanish, Chinese, Indonesian and Persian.
landing.s1d: Pick a surah and play it verse by verse with your favorite reciter.
landing.s2d: Open the tafsir and the word-by-word meaning right next to the verse.
landing.s3d: Practice from memory and come back when the app says a verse is due.

landing.whyTitle: A Quran learning platform for memorizing, understanding and reciting
landing.whyP1: TafsirFlow combines verse-by-verse audio from renowned reciters with word-by-word meaning, transliteration and classical tafsir. You hear a verse, see every word light up, and read what it means and what scholars explained about it – all on one screen, on your phone or computer.
landing.whyP2: Whether you want to memorize the Quran (hifz), understand its meaning (fahm) or improve your recitation (tilawa and tajweed), the app adapts: hide words and recite from memory, repeat verses or whole passages, and let spaced repetition show you what to review today. A kids mode makes learning simple and fun for children.
landing.q1: How can I memorize the Quran with TafsirFlow?
landing.a1: Listen to a verse, then switch on “Hide half” or “Hide all” and recite it from memory. Reveal the verse and rate how well you knew it. The app schedules your next review after 1, 3, 7, 14, 30 and 90 days, so verses move into long-term memory.
landing.q2: Which languages and translations are available?
landing.a2: The interface and the Quran translation are available in German, English, Arabic, French, Spanish, Chinese, Indonesian and Persian. Transliteration in Latin letters helps you read the Arabic text.
landing.q3: Is there a tafsir (Quran commentary) for every verse?
landing.a3: Classical commentaries such as Ibn Kathir (abridged) are shown next to the verse with their source. Where no tafsir exists in your language, English sources are shown instead.
landing.a4: Yes. You can listen, read and memorize for free. A free account saves your progress, bookmarks and review plan on all your devices. Visitors without an account can open tafsir for a limited number of verses per day.
landing.q5: Is there a mode for children?
landing.a5: Yes. Kids mode uses large text, bright colors, simple buttons and star rewards, so children can listen, follow word by word and practise short surahs.
